fields.name: job_name
fields.label: Job name
fields.help: A label for this run and its results.

fields.name: pdb_path
fields.label: Structure (PDB)
fields.help: Upload a protein or protein–ligand PDB, or choose a bundled official example. Required unless multiple structures are supplied.
fields.help_note: PDB contents are mapped to --pdb_path. Preserve HETATM records for ligand, nucleotide and metal context. This upstream parser reads PDB, not mmCIF.

fields.name: pdb_path_multi
fields.label: Multiple structures (JSON)
fields.help: Object mapping unique names to PDB contents or bundled references. Leave the single-structure field blank.
fields.help_note: Example: {"first": "bio-tools://ligandmpnn/inputs/1BC8.pdb", "second": "bio-tools://ligandmpnn/inputs/4GYT.pdb"}. The service creates a native --pdb_path_multi file with job-local paths; server paths are not accepted.

fields.name: chains_to_design
fields.label: Chains to design or score
fields.help: Comma-separated chain IDs, e.g. A,B. Other chains remain fixed context. Blank selects all parsed protein chains.

fields.name: parse_these_chains_only
fields.label: Parse only these chains
fields.help: Comma-separated chain IDs. Excludes every other chain, including its ligand atoms, from parsing and output; blank keeps all chains.

fields.name: parse_atoms_with_zero_occupancy
fields.label: Include atoms with zero occupancy
fields.help: Upstream normally discards atoms whose occupancy is zero.

fields.name: model_type
fields.label: Model
fields.help: The upstream default is ProteinMPNN. Select LigandMPNN to condition sequence design or scoring on non-protein atoms.

fields.name: checkpoint_protein_mpnn
fields.label: ProteinMPNN checkpoint
fields.help: Official checkpoint filename in the configured model directory. Noise is the training backbone noise in angstroms.

fields.name: checkpoint_ligand_mpnn
fields.label: LigandMPNN checkpoint
fields.help: Official checkpoint filename in the configured model directory. Noise is the training backbone noise in angstroms.

fields.name: checkpoint_soluble_mpnn
fields.label: SolubleMPNN checkpoint
fields.help: Official checkpoint filename in the configured model directory. Noise is the training backbone noise in angstroms.

fields.name: checkpoint_per_residue_label_membrane_mpnn
fields.label: Membrane: per-residue labels checkpoint
fields.help: Official checkpoint filename in the configured model directory. Noise is the training backbone noise in angstroms.

fields.name: checkpoint_global_label_membrane_mpnn
fields.label: Membrane: global label checkpoint
fields.help: Official checkpoint filename in the configured model directory. Noise is the training backbone noise in angstroms.

fields.name: batch_size
fields.label: Batch size
fields.help: Samples evaluated together; reduce to 1 for a small CPU run.

fields.name: number_of_batches
fields.label: Number of batches
fields.help: Total samples = batch size × number of batches. For scoring, upstream recommends at least 10 batches to average decoding-order effects.

fields.name: temperature
fields.label: Sampling temperature
fields.help: Positive temperature; higher values give more sequence diversity.

fields.name: seed
fields.label: Random seed
fields.help: Zero chooses a random seed. A nonzero seed is reproducible within the same runtime.

fields.name: use_sequence
fields.label: Condition scores on sequence
fields.help: Use the sequence in the PDB as well as the backbone. Disable for backbone-only probabilities. Scoring writes a .pt dictionary of per-residue probabilities and statistics.

fields.name: fixed_residues
fields.label: Fixed residues
fields.help: Space-separated PDB residue IDs, e.g. C1 C2 C3. These residues retain their input amino acids.
fields.help_note: Uses chain + author residue number + optional insertion code, e.g. B82A. Unlike original ProteinMPNN, numbering gaps are not filled with X.

fields.name: fixed_residues_multi
fields.label: Fixed residues per structure (JSON)
fields.help: Object keyed by the names in pdb_path_multi, with a space-separated residue list per structure. Overrides the common list for that structure.

fields.name: redesigned_residues
fields.label: Redesign only these residues
fields.help: Space-separated PDB residue IDs; every other residue is fixed. Choose this or fixed_residues.
fields.help_note: Uses chain + author residue number + optional insertion code, e.g. B82A. Unlike original ProteinMPNN, numbering gaps are not filled with X.

fields.name: redesigned_residues_multi
fields.label: Redesign only these residues per structure (JSON)
fields.help: Object keyed by the names in pdb_path_multi, with a space-separated residue list per structure. Overrides the common list for that structure.

fields.name: symmetry_residues
fields.label: Tied residue groups
fields.help: Comma-separated residues within each group, | between groups: C1,C2,C3|C4,C5|C6,C7. Groups cannot overlap.

fields.name: symmetry_weights
fields.label: Tied residue weights
fields.help: Matching weights for every group: 0.33,0.33,0.33|0.5,0.5|0.5,0.5. Required with explicit design symmetry; finite negative weights are supported.

fields.name: homo_oligomer
fields.label: Tie all parsed protein chains
fields.help: Upstream ties matching PDB residue numbers and insertion codes across ALL parsed chains with equal weights. Chains must have identical residue IDs. Use parse-only chains to restrict the assembly.

fields.name: bias_AA
fields.label: Global amino-acid bias
fields.help: Comma-separated AA:value pairs, e.g. W:3.0,P:3.0,C:3.0,A:-3.0. Positive values favor an amino acid.

fields.name: omit_AA
fields.label: Globally omitted amino acids
fields.help: One-letter codes to exclude, e.g. CDFGHILMNPQRSTVWY leaves A, E and K. LigandMPNN samples the 20 standard amino acids.

fields.name: bias_AA_per_residue
fields.label: Per-residue amino-acid bias
fields.help: JSON keyed by PDB residue IDs, e.g. {"C1": {"G": -0.3, "P": 10.8}}.

fields.name: bias_AA_per_residue_multi
fields.label: Per-residue amino-acid bias per structure
fields.help: JSON keyed by pdb_path_multi names; each value is a per-residue object. Overrides common guidance for that structure.

fields.name: omit_AA_per_residue
fields.label: Per-residue amino-acid exclusions
fields.help: JSON keyed by PDB residue IDs, e.g. {"C1": "ACDEFGHIKLMNPQRSTVW"} leaves Y at C1.

fields.name: omit_AA_per_residue_multi
fields.label: Per-residue amino-acid exclusions per structure
fields.help: JSON keyed by pdb_path_multi names; each value is a per-residue object. Overrides common guidance for that structure.

fields.name: ligand_mpnn_use_atom_context
fields.label: Use ligand atom context
fields.help: LigandMPNN only: condition on nearby non-protein atoms, including small molecules, nucleotides and metals.

fields.name: ligand_mpnn_use_side_chain_context
fields.label: Use fixed side chains as context
fields.help: LigandMPNN only: use side-chain atoms of fixed residues as additional context.

fields.name: ligand_mpnn_cutoff_for_score
fields.label: Ligand score cutoff (Å)
fields.help: Selects residues near context atoms for the reported ligand confidence. It does not set the model’s atom-context neighborhood.

fields.name: transmembrane_buried
fields.label: Buried membrane residues
fields.help: Per-residue membrane model only: space-separated PDB residue IDs, e.g. C1 C2 C3 C11. Class 2 (hydrophobic).

fields.name: transmembrane_interface
fields.label: Membrane interface residues
fields.help: Per-residue membrane model only: e.g. C4 C5 C6 C22. Class 1 (polar); unlisted residues are class 0. Lists must not overlap.

fields.name: global_transmembrane_label
fields.label: Global membrane label
fields.help: Global membrane model only: 0 = soluble, 1 = transmembrane.

fields.name: pack_side_chains
fields.label: Pack designed side chains
fields.help: Run the official side-chain packing model after sequence design.

fields.name: number_of_packs_per_design
fields.label: Packs per sequence
fields.help: Independent packed structures per generated sequence. Use 1 for one pack; upstream run.py produces no packed files at 0 despite the README’s fast-example text.

fields.name: sc_num_denoising_steps
fields.label: Packing denoising steps
fields.help: Number of recycling/denoising steps per pack.

fields.name: sc_num_samples
fields.label: Packing mixture samples
fields.help: Samples drawn from each mixture distribution; the highest-likelihood sample is used.

fields.name: pack_with_ligand_context
fields.label: Pack with ligand context
fields.help: Consider ligand, DNA and other context atoms during packing.

fields.name: repack_everything
fields.label: Repack fixed residues too
fields.help: Off preserves side chains at fixed positions and uses them as packing context.

fields.name: force_hetatm
fields.label: Write packed context atoms as HETATM
fields.help: Force context atoms in packed output PDBs to use HETATM records.

fields.name: packed_suffix
fields.label: Packed PDB suffix
fields.help: Suffix appended to packed PDB filenames; letters, digits, underscores, dots and hyphens only.

fields.name: save_stats
fields.label: Save design statistics
fields.help: Write .pt statistics including sequences, probabilities, decoding order, masks, seed and temperature.

fields.name: fasta_seq_separation
fields.label: FASTA chain separator
fields.help: Separator between chains in output FASTA. PDB output preserves chain IDs and residue numbering.

fields.name: file_ending
fields.label: Output filename ending
fields.help: Optional ending such as _xyz; letters, digits, underscores, dots and hyphens only.

fields.name: zero_indexed
fields.label: Number output designs from zero
fields.help: Start designed PDB file numbering at 0 instead of 1.

fields.name: verbose
fields.label: Print progress
fields.help: Include upstream progress messages in the run log.
